headings.text: has been a physiotherapist for 16 years and runs Fisio4you. He leads musculoskeletal physiotherapy, from sports injuries to low back and neck pain and rehab after surgery.
At the clinic he has what treatment calls for close at hand: ultrasound in assessment, a 100 m² rehabilitation gym and the recovery area, with an ice bath and sauna.
My pain has lasted several months. Can physiotherapy help?
Does ultrasound hurt or use radiation?
How is ultrasound different from an MRI?
Can I keep training during treatment?
What should I bring to my first appointment?

Hi! I have pain in my knee in my shoulder in my back in my neck in my hip in my ankle or foot somewhere else and I'd like to get back to training get back to competing get through the day without pain

findings.message: 1 large-set statement(s) run past 3 lines at 1440px: "has been a physiotherapist for 16 years …" → 4 lines at 36px
findings.fix: A statement set large is about 30 words. Cut it, or set the rest as ordinary body text.
Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.
Prefer a filled surface or no box.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.
Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: Large text lies under another element at some scroll position: "conditions" (screen 2, 100% hidden); "Then, the plan." (screen 6, 38% hidden); "Mário Barroso" (screen 7, 75% hidden); "has been a physiotherapist for 16 years and runs" (screen 7, 31% hidden)
findings.fix: Nothing may sit on top of a headline or statement. Move the picture, shorten the pinned run, or raise the text above it (z-index) and give it a ground.
Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.
One blurred sticky bar at most; glass cards are a tell.

findings.message: With reduced motion requested, 2 text block(s) on the first screen stay invisible: "Musculoskeletal Physiotherapy", "Dermatofunctional Physiotherapy"
findings.fix: Put every hidden starting state inside @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference); the reduced page is the finished page (references/motion.md §8).
